sources.snippet: 🧠 What is LoRA? LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) freezes pre-trained model weights and injects trainable rank decomposition matrices into each transformer layer. This reduces trainable parameters by 99% while achieving comparable performance to full fine-tuning.
